data.long_description:
Experience sophisticated urban living in the heart of Downtown Dubai. This elegant residence offers a perfect blend of modern design and comfort, featuring high-end finishes, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a spacious layout that fills the home with natural light. Residents enjoy breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and the dynamic city skyline, along with access to world-class facilities.

Features:

⦁ Contemporary design with premium finishes
⦁ Spacious living and dining areas
⦁ Fully equipped modern kitchen
⦁ Built-in wardrobes and ample storage
⦁ Floor-to-ceiling windows with panoramic views
⦁ High-quality fixtures and fittings

Amenities:

⦁ Infinity Swimming pool
⦁ Fully equipped fitness center
⦁ Children’s play area and dedicated pool
⦁ Multi-purpose hall and lounge area
⦁ 24-hour security and concierge service
⦁ Covered parking
⦁ Direct access to Dubai Mall and public transport
